translationRepairs: In the first year of Zhengsheng the Tibetans raided Tao Prefecture. Shide was ordered to join Minister of War Wang Xiaojie in attacking them. At Mount Suluohan they fought the Tibetan generals Lun Qinling and Zanpo. The imperial army was defeated, and Shide was demoted to acting magistrate of Yuan Prefecture.

In the first year of Zhengsheng the Tibetans raided Tao Prefecture. Shide was ordered to join Minister of War Wang Xiaojie in attacking them. At Mount Suluohan they fought the Tibetan generals Lun Qinling and Zanpo. The imperial army was defeated, and Shide was demoted to supernumerary marshal of Yuan Prefecture.
員外司馬 is a supernumerary marshal, not a magistrate.
In the second year of Shengli the Turks invaded, and he was again ordered to inspect the prefectural governor of Bing and to serve as grand general of the Tianbing Army.
In the second year of Shengli the Turks invaded, and he was again ordered to serve as acting administrator of Bing Prefecture and to serve as grand general of the Tianbing Army.
檢校并州長史 means acting administrator of Bingzhou.
Su Honghui, deputy grand general of the rear army, feared the enemy's numbers, cast off his armor, and fled.
Su Honghui, grand general of the rear army, feared the enemy's numbers, cast off his armor, and fled.
後軍總管 is the rear-army commander, not a deputy.

Empress Wu once produced Shide's old memorial and showed it to him. Renjie was deeply ashamed and said to others, "I was so contained by Lord Lou, and only now do I know how far I fall short of Lord Lou."

Empress Wu once produced Shide's old memorial and showed it to him. Renjie was deeply ashamed and said to others, "I have been so tolerated by Lord Lou, and only now do I know how far I fall short of Lord Lou."
含 here means to bear with or tolerate.

At the end of the Gaozong reign he served as deputy grand general and followed Minister of Works Liu Shenli west to attack the Tibetans. They fought at the Da Fei River and were captured by the enemy.

At the end of the Gaozong reign he served as deputy grand general and followed Minister of Works Liu Shenli west to attack the Tibetans. They fought at the Da Fei River and he was captured by the enemy.
爲賊所獄 refers to Xiaojie's own capture.

When the Tibetans broke Yanqi, the grand general of the Anxi Circuit and Right Vice Director Wei Daojia together with Vice Commissioner Yan Wengu suffered defeat. Xiujing gathered the remaining troops and stabilized the lands of Anxi.

When the Tibetans broke Yanqi, the grand general of the Anxi Circuit and Right Chancellor of Wenchang Wei Daijia together with Vice Commissioner Yan Wengu suffered defeat. Xiujing gathered the remaining troops and stabilized the lands of Anxi.
韋待價 is Wei Daijia; 文昌右相 is Right Chancellor of the Wenchang Department.
She also said to Wei Yuanzhong, Yang Zaisi, Li Jiao, Yao Yuanchong, Li Jiongxiu, and others, "Xiujing is well versed in frontier affairs. Not one of you equals ten of him."
She also said to Wei Yuanzhong, Yang Zaisi, Li Jiao, Yao Yuanchong, Li Jiongxiu, and others, "Xiujing is well versed in frontier affairs. Ten of you would not match one of him."
十不當一 means ten of them would not match one Xiujing.

At the time Emperor Zhongzong was in the Eastern Palace. About to depart, he submitted a report to the Crown Prince, saying, "The brothers Zhang Yizhi have fortunately received favor and often attend banquets within the forbidden palace, indulging themselves beyond propriety.

At the time Emperor Zhongzong was in the Eastern Palace. About to depart, he submitted a report to the Crown Prince, saying, "Zhang Yizhi and his brothers have fortunately received favor and often attend banquets within the forbidden palace, indulging themselves beyond propriety.
張易之兄弟 means Zhang Yizhi and his brothers.
His original name was Renyan; it was changed because the sound resembled the taboo name of Emperor Ruizong.
His original name was Rendan; it was changed because the sound resembled the taboo name of Emperor Ruizong.
